rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for conspicuous pomp or showy display, especially at a public event.

example.english: That awards ceremony had a lot of glitz and the whole scene was eye-catching.
example.traditional: 嗰個頒獎禮搞到好有排場，成個場面都好搶眼。
